gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-007 identifies an omitted log(1/epsilon) contribution and an invalid independent epsilon-delta complexity guarantee. Gold I001 instead concerns the missing polynomial (1-q)^(-2d) dependence caused by the approximation scale and covering entropy as q approaches one. These are distinct parameter-dependence obligations, despite both occurring in approximation-complexity calculations.

Both entries identify the same failure in lemsumD: the residual block adds FFN(Z) to Z, but the cited gating construction does not provide the required negative DM correction in the target column. Consequently the claimed block is not constructed and the unsupported decrement propagates through the arithmetic and downstream approximation chain.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The Gating Lemma is used to realize a tokenwise negative residual decrement that its stated output does not supply under the actual transformer residual formula, so the claimed arithmetic block and dependent construction chain are unsupported.
